dishes.name: Reibekuchen
dishes.desc: Crisp grated-potato pancakes, served hot with apple sauce or dark bread. A Rhineland street and brewery classic.

dishes.name: Düsseldorfer Senfrostbraten
dishes.desc: Roast beef coated in the city's mustard and braised with onions. A traditional meal in the old-town breweries.

dishes.name: Düsseldorf mustard
dishes.desc: The medium-hot mustard made in the city since the 19th century, eaten with Mett and rolls or sausages.

dishes.name: Bergische waffeln
dishes.desc: Heart-shaped waffles served with hot cherries and cream, from the Bergisches Land around Düsseldorf.

dishes.name: Bergische Kaffeetafel
dishes.desc: Afternoon spread of waffles, rice pudding, dark bread, cheese and jam, served in traditional Bergisches Land cafés.
